name: South Bay Galleria
description: South Bay Galleria is a premier three-level shopping destination in the heart of Redondo Beach, featuring over 140 retailers including Macy's, Kohl's, and AMC Dine-In Theatres. Open daily with extended holiday hours, the Galleria offers an exceptional mix of shopping, dining, and entertainment experiences for the South Bay community. Whether you're browsing the latest trends, catching a movie, or enjoying a meal, South Bay Galleria provides a vibrant and welcoming environment for every occasion.
